{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the cleaned data
df_clean = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df_clean['revenue_clean'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove the 6 QA rows with revenue = 999999.99
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

df_clean = df_clean.drop(columns=['revenue_clean'])

# Now, check the cross-tabulation of channel and customer_segment
print('Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:')
print(pd.crosstab(df_clean['channel'], df_clean['customer_segment']))

# Also check conversion rate by segment
print('\nConversion rate by customer_segment:')
print(df_clean.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean())

# Check if the email group has more loyal/returning customers
email_group = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'email']
paid_search_group = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search']

print('\nEmail group: customer_segment distribution:')
print(email_group['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True))
print('\nPaid search group: customer_segment distribution:')
print(paid_search_group['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True))"}
